families.training: No learned alpha estimator; window selection still consumes trials.

families.distribution: residual quantiles only if qualified, separate calibrated event heads

families.prohibition: No autoML/unbounded Bayesian search; package/version/portable runtime proof later.

modules.name: qualification_lab
modules.role: date-aligned temporal folds, all trials and immutable evidence

modules.name: regime_risk
modules.role: trailing summaries plus separately qualified event probabilities

modules.name: analog_event
modules.role: lagged distances and mature event outcomes, noncausal associations

modules.name: direction_range
modules.role: exact tasks, calibrated event outputs and distributions

modules.name: patterns
modules.role: causal detectors, compatible observation kinds only

patterns_proposed.rule: Crossing of trailing completed-bar 20 and 60 valuation-session means; timestamp last input availability
Current completed close strictly above prior20 completed closes maximum or below minimum; current excluded from prior window

analogs_proposed.features: same declared lagged block scaled within fit region
analogs_proposed.distance: Euclidean on training-standardised features; weights frozen
analogs_proposed.admission: candidate label interval fully matured and outcome known before current cutoff
analogs_proposed.dependence: group overlapping intervals/economic entities; show effective evidence; no event-count guarantee
analogs_proposed.scope: same approved market-kind pool and return basis; across-instrument extension separately declared
analogs_proposed.tie_break: ascending distance, then most recent origin, then instrument_id
analogs_proposed.de_overlap: greedy nearest-first selection rejects candidate whose label interval overlaps a selected candidate from same economic entity; cross-entity/date dependence still reported
analogs_proposed.sparse: show descriptive cases and unknown precision; no calibrated probability claim without qualification

counts: Two learned families are not two artefacts and not one per ticker. Scope and qualification determine artefacts.

llm_factors.route: separate Lambda route workers shared typed client SDK
llm_factors.prediction_evaluation: independent SCI-06 proper scores and ablations

regime_module_proposed.trend: trailing60valuation-session TRI return >0 up,<0 down,=0 flat
regime_module_proposed.volatility: sample standard deviation trailing20 log returns; do not annualise with fixed252 for NAV without approved schedule
regime_module_proposed.high_volatility: above80thpercentile of trailingvol20 observed within fit partition; threshold frozen for inference
regime_module_proposed.missing: no regime if required eligible observations absent
regime_module_proposed.use: descriptive stratum/feature; not probability or causal market state

event_module_proposed.event_origin: last eligible completed valuation before evidenced release_known_at; after-close release cannot enter earlier-origin predictor
event_module_proposed.features: declared public release fields only, no future surprise-consensus reconstruction
event_module_proposed.outcomes: separate terminal total return and arithmetic benchmark excess; same currency/endpoints
event_module_proposed.confounding: display overlapping releases/market events and calendar/sector comparators; association not causation
event_module_proposed.search: event-kind/window definitions predeclared and consume trials; no post-result cohort selection
